subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in Column 'A' and
stimulus: Column 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in Column 'B' than required. 1 5=5 Column A Column B (a) Human beings did (i) roaming here and there not come to collect food. (b) People passed their days (ii) were their abodes. (c) They would eat (iii) to the world as civilized persons. (d) The caves of hills (iv) fruits and meat of and mountains animals. (e) They were satisfied (v) came into being. (vi) with the filling of their stomach only. (vii) sustain their livelihood.
